summary: Completed backend testing of Marketing Portal F14-F17 features. Backend APIs are functional with 47/52 tests passing. Frontend is accessible but detailed UI testing was limited due to navigation complexity in preview stable mode.

medium_bugs.issue: GET with account_id filter returns items with wrong account_id (2 items mismatched)
medium_bugs.impact: Product launches not filtering correctly by account - violates F14 account scope requirement
medium_bugs.test_evidence: Backend test line 369: Found 2 items with wrong account_id when filtering by account_id=marketing-dash-fix

minor_issues.issue: POST without required account_id returns 422 instead of 400
minor_issues.impact: HTTP status code inconsistency - FastAPI Pydantic validation returns 422 for missing required fields, which is technically correct but tests expected 400
minor_issues.note: This is acceptable behavior - 422 is the correct HTTP status for validation errors per RFC

minor_issues.issue: CSV upload with Indonesian headers results in status='mapping' instead of 'ready'
minor_issues.impact: Auto-mapping couldn't map all required fields - this is expected behavior when column names don't match exactly
minor_issues.note: This is correct behavior - manual mapping is required when auto-mapping is incomplete

integration_issues.issue: Difficulty navigating to Marketing Portal programmatically in preview stable mode
integration_issues.note: Manual navigation works, but automated testing is challenging due to hash-based routing and static build mode

success_percentage.frontend: 60% (login and portal selection work, but detailed module testing incomplete)

medium: Fix product launches endpoint to properly filter by account_id - currently returns items with wrong account_id
low: Consider standardizing HTTP status codes for missing required fields (currently mix of 400 and 422)
Improve auto-mapping for Indonesian CSV headers to reduce manual mapping needs
action_item_for_main_agent.frontend_testing_note: Frontend detailed testing was limited due to navigation complexity in preview stable mode. Manual testing recommended for: (1) Data Import wizard with all 6 steps, (2) Live Sessions dialog with host picker, (3) Ads dialog with calculated fields display, (4) Samples form with creator and catalog item pickers, (5) Account filters across all modules

f17_data_import.notes: Source types, templates, context options, and upload validation all working correctly. Auto-mapping works but may need manual adjustment for non-standard headers. AI assist is optional as designed.

f14_account_scope.notes: Account filtering works for 6/7 tested endpoints. Product launches has a bug where it returns items with wrong account_id. All summary endpoints accept account_id parameter.

f16_crud_ads.notes: Full CRUD working. Calculated fields (CTR, CPA, ROAS, CPC, CVR) computed correctly by server. Platform list endpoint works.

f16_crud_live.notes: Full CRUD working. Calculated fields (engagement_rate, conversion_rate, aov) computed correctly. Host assignment validation works. CRITICAL BUG FIX VERIFIED: Live summary now shows revenue > 0 (was Rp 0 before).

f16_live_analytics.notes: All 7 analytics endpoints return 200. Overview shows correct revenue.

f15_samples_master.notes: Samples require account_id. Creator validation works (must be assigned to account). Total HPP calculated correctly.

f15_product_launches.notes: Endpoint exists and requires account_id, but filtering by account_id has issues (see backend_issues).

verification_evidence.backend_test_output: 47 tests passed, 5 tests failed (4 are acceptable 422 vs 400 status code differences, 1 is product launches filtering bug)

verification_evidence.calculated_fields: Ads CTR=3.0, CPA=13333.33, ROAS=3.0 all match expected values. Live engagement=37.5%, conversion=5.0%, aov=50000 all correct.
verification_evidence.account_scope: Tested 7 endpoints with account_id filter, 6 work correctly, 1 (product-launches) has bug
verification_evidence.host_assignment: Context options for live_sessions with account_id returns only assigned hosts
